title: Collect every VKS cluster from a Supervisor namespace in stable order
prompt:
Platform engineering needs a reproducible inventory of the VKS clusters visible in one vSphere Supervisor namespace. Complete `VcfVksClusterInventory/VcfVksClusterInventory.psm1`.

Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operation `Vcenter.Namespaces.User.Instances_list` and its generated VMware VCF PowerCLI 9.1 binding in official VMware sources. Also research the namespaced `clusters` collection for `cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1` in official Kubernetes project sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Kubernetes Cluster API resource requests are not VMware operationIds; do not represent the Kubernetes request as an operationId from the VMware specification.

VCF PowerCLI 9.1 is installed by the environment. Keep the manifest prerequisite on `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` version `13.5.0.25380678`. It loads the genuine `VMware.Bindings.vSphere.Api.IVcenterNamespacesUserInstancesApi` binding used by the module. Do not install, download, copy, generate, vendor, intercept, replace, or imitate any VMware module, assembly, binding, or OpenAPI file.

Implement and export exactly:

`Get-VcfVksClusterInventory -NamespaceApi <IVcenterNamespacesUserInstancesApi> -Namespace <string> -KubernetesToken <string> [-PageSize <int>] [-KubernetesScheme http|https] [-SkipCertificateCheck]`

Requirements:

- Reject a blank namespace, a blank or header-unsafe Kubernetes bearer token, and a non-positive page size before making traffic. `PageSize` defaults to 200. `KubernetesScheme` defaults to `https`.
- Invoke the genuine binding method `VcenterNamespacesUserInstancesList($null, $null)` exactly once. Both documented optionals are unset: the `filter` object, its `username`, and `groups` must be omitted completely, not sent as null, empty, false, or defaults. From the complete returned array, require exactly one summary whose `namespace` is an ordinal, case-sensitive match. Require its `master_host` to be a bare IP/FQDN authority with optional port; reject credentials, paths, query, and fragment.
- Against that `master_host`, retrieve the VKS Cluster API collection with bodyless GETs to `/apis/cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/{namespace}/clusters`. Put `limit=<PageSize>` first on every request. Omit `continue` on the first page. When response `metadata.continue` is nonempty, append it second as an RFC 3986 percent-encoded query value and fetch the next page. Continue until `metadata.continue` is absent or empty.
- Send `Accept: application/json` and exactly one `Authorization: Bearer <KubernetesToken>` header to Kubernetes. Do not forward `vmware-api-session-id`. Do not send a body, `Content-Type`, or `Content-Length`. Leave `fieldSelector`, `labelSelector`, `resourceVersion`, `resourceVersionMatch`, `timeoutSeconds`, `watch`, `allowWatchBookmarks`, and `sendInitialEvents` completely absent.
- Validate every page as a `cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1` `ClusterList` with non-null `metadata` and `items`. Every item must be a `cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1` `Cluster` with nonblank string `metadata.name` and `metadata.uid`, and `metadata.namespace` exactly equal to the requested namespace. Reject null items, malformed continuation data, a nonempty continuation on an empty page, or a repeated continuation instead of looping forever.
- Buffer every page, then emit the complete collection ordered by `metadata.name` using `StringComparer.Ordinal`, with `metadata.uid` as an ordinal tie-breaker. Preserve each complete decoded Cluster object. Do not trust page or wire order and do not write progress or diagnostics to the success pipeline.
- A non-success Kubernetes response or malformed success response is terminating. Error messages must not include either authentication token, a response body, or underlying transport exception text. Dispose only the Kubernetes client created by this function; the caller owns `NamespaceApi` and its transport.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Edit only `VcfVksClusterInventory/VcfVksClusterInventory.psm1`; do not modify `tests/**`, `docs/**`, or the manifest.
scenario: a vCenter namespace discovery selects one Supervisor API authority, then a VKS Cluster API collection spans three continuation-linked pages whose item order reverses on the second complete read
constraint: the loopback service derives its two-route allow-list from the protected focused contract and its fsynced request log proves exact vCenter optional omission plus complete, ordered Kubernetes continuation traversal
